chars.counting_rule: author runtime HTML, page CSS and story controller only; excludes chassis, GSAP, images, audits and generated reports

changes: Centralized image creation and initial GSAP placement so seed, echo and context identities share one readable construction path.
Centralized owned event listeners and teardown, preventing registration/removal drift and adding lost-pointer-capture recovery.
A cross-audit added a disposed guard to the public navigation API and exposed that state for deterministic lifecycle inspection.
Removed an unused CSS token, reused layer geometry, and expressed the portrait image dimensions relative to its canonical frame.
Used the chassis clamp and the media query's canonical reduced-motion state without changing authored timeline labels or times.
Cross-audit added a failure-only visible fallback that reuses the existing title, summary and seven-step lineage when GSAP or any required image cannot load; normal rendering remains unchanged.

tests.name: fixed-state DOM and pixel equivalence
tests.evidence: Canonical navigation fields, stage and image rectangles, identities, opacity, transforms, borders, captions, portrait and field opacity were deeply equal for all seven states; the candidate additionally exposes lifecycle-only disposed=false.

tests.name: input and navigation
tests.evidence: All six forward and six reverse keyboard transitions, bidirectional wheel, bidirectional touch, reset and subsequent replay reached the expected settled state.

tests.name: pointer interruption
tests.evidence: lostpointercapture aborted an in-progress touch gesture without advancing; the next real swipe worked normally.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: Every keyboard step immediately selected its exact timeline label with animating=false at 1280x720.

tests.name: teardown and reinit
tests.evidence: pagehide set readiness false, removed input behavior, killed motion and made direct public navigation a no-op with disposed=true; reload restored one stage, 30 network images and one portrait.

tests.name: original selfcheck
tests.evidence: No clipping, escape, overlap, undersized text, failed resource or runtime error.

cross_audit.page_contract: The learner should understand that one network image persists through copying and technical reuse because five seeds become twenty-five identifiable copies, exchange into five technical contexts, and gather into the same 84 by 84 portrait.

author_layer.excluded: 30 JPEG/PNG evidence assets, shared chassis, GSAP/vendor, selfcheck, provenance, reports and screenshots
author_layer.readability: HTML 53 lines/max 146; CSS 203/max 88; JS 458/max 108. Named identity, geometry, timeline, state, input and ownership paths remain readable; no minification.

cross_audit.revision: The prior candidate threw when GSAP was unavailable and silently lost evidence when an image failed. A failure-only fallback now clones the existing title, summary and ordered seven-step lineage into a visible card, fits both viewports, disables the disposed public controller and owns resize/pagehide. Normal state markup, assets and GSAP timeline are unchanged.

evidence.fixed_states: Fresh cross-audit: all seven named states at 1600x900 and 1280x720 under normal and reduced motion (28 pairs) retained deeply equal controller state. Normal is AE0 throughout; four reduced pairs show only max-AE1 JPEG decode noise, also reproducible between repeated formal screenshots. The earlier 32-pair run including focus remains AE0.
evidence.identity_and_assets: 5 seeds, 20 echoes, 5 contexts and one 84x84 portrait retain identity/order, source assets, rectangles, opacity, transforms, border colors and captions.
evidence.motion_and_inputs: All named GSAP labels/times, normal tween completion, rapid retarget, keyboard, wheel, real CDP browser touch swipe, double reset, reduced immediate selection and lostpointercapture recovery pass.
evidence.resize: 1600x900 to 1280x720 preserves a 0.8 stage scale, 31 loaded images and zero overflow.
evidence.fallback: Aborting base.js, GSAP or a required source image shows the visible seven-step lineage with no page/console error; 1280x720 remains fitted.
evidence.lifecycle: pagehide kills active GSAP work, timer and owned inputs; cached API is inert and ready=false; reload restores exactly 30 network images plus one portrait in state five.
evidence.selfcheck: Initial and portrait states: zero clipping, escape, overlap, tiny text, runtime error or failed resource.

cross_audit.mini: required_if_used_as_auxiliary; improved full is above 10,000 author characters

rejected_changes.change: encode coordinate records as anonymous tuples or collapse timeline calls into an opaque table
rejected_changes.reason: would reduce the sample's value as a learnable authored-motion reference

rejected_changes.change: remove images, states, captions, semantic list, transitions or inspection inputs
rejected_changes.reason: would lower narrative, visual, accessibility or interaction quality
